newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moroccan importers seek 27,000 tonnes wheat-trader.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan importers seek 27,000 tonnes wheat-trader.

text.p: Private Moroccan importers are in the market this week to purchase a total of 27,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat, European grain traders said on Monday.
Importers will tender on January 21 for two cargoes of 6,000 tonnes each for delivery by January 31 to the ports of Nador and Safi.
One trader however doubted exporters would be able to meet the tight delivery deadline.
Moroccan importers will also tender on January 23 for 15,000 tonnes of wheat for delivery between February 25 and March 5 to the ports of Nador and Safi.
